Which is worse? Wine or beer? Tofu or lentils? Compare the carbon emissions of the food and drink you have every day.

For each pair of foods or drinks, say which one carries the higher total emissions, measured in grams of CO2 equivalent.

The figure covers the whole life cycle: growing or rearing it, processing, packaging, transport, the shop, and keeping it at home.

The answer depends on the food and on the size of the serving. Every card shows one serving.
